EpochRewards sysvar read, init, distribute, and deactivate functions.

# Purpose
This header file declares the interface for the `EpochRewards` sysvar in the runtime. It includes one read function, [`fd_sysvar_epoch_rewards_read`](<#fd_sysvar_epoch_rewards_read>), which loads the current sysvar value from `funk` and returns `NULL` when the account is missing or has zero lamports. It also declares functions to initialize the sysvar, distribute rewards, and mark the sysvar as inactive, using `fd_bank_t`, `fd_accdb_user_t`, and `fd_capture_ctx_t` to update account state. The file contains only function prototypes and include guards, so it serves as a small API definition for epoch reward sysvar handling.

- `fd_sysvar_epoch_rewards_distribute`
